questions.source_content:
INSPECTION COMPLIANCE REPORT
Municipal Corporation Administrative Wing, Jalore
Date: 12 November 2025 (Ref No: RAJ/219)
Subject: Monthly Stock Audit of Essential Medicines under Free Drug Distribution Scheme (Phase-4)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Jalore division are hereby informed that under 'Monthly Stock Audit of Essential Medicines under Free Drug Distribution Scheme', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 17 November in the central monthly wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #319) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Jalore, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and monthly movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Jalore), 2. Budget Reconciliation #129, 3. Digital Indexing.
Nodal Officer (Audit)
Mahendra Singh Rathore
solution_steps: 1. Go to INSERT -> Header/Footer and Page Number.
2. Go to DESIGN -> Watermark (and Page Border).

INSPECTION COMPLIANCE REPORT
Municipal Corporation Administrative Wing, Jalore
Date: 12 November 2025 (Ref No: RAJ/219)
Subject: Monthly Stock Audit of Essential Medicines under Free Drug Distribution Scheme (Phase-4)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Jalore division are hereby informed that under 'Monthly Stock Audit of Essential Medicines under Free Drug Distribution Scheme', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 17 November in the central monthly wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #319) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Jalore, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and monthly movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Jalore), 2. Budget Reconciliation #129, 3. Digital Indexing.
Nodal Officer (Audit)
Mahendra Singh Rathore
